name: Elopura Marathon Sandakan 2026
short_description: The Elopura Marathon Sandakan 2026 is a full marathon, half marathon, and 10km race held in Sandakan, Sabah, Malaysia on 22 November 2026.
ai_summary: The Elopura Marathon Sandakan 2026 is a road race scheduled for 22 November 2026 in Sandakan, Sabah, Malaysia. Organized by the Persatuan Ortopedik Sandakan, the event offers full marathon, half marathon, and 10km distances. Pricing is set at RM140 for the half marathon and RM170 for the full marathon, per elopuramarathon.com.

core_facts.price_range: MYR HM RM140 / FM RM170 (per elopuramarathon.com)

pros: Seven-hour marathon cut-off, with pacers for 4:30 to 6:00 finishes
14 water stations on the marathon, with bananas and a cooling station
Prize money ten deep in both open and veteran categories
Counts towards the Sabah Marathon Series medal with Kota Kinabalu and Tawau
Route along the Sandakan coast and through the town centre
cons: Very humid: 26°C and 100% humidity at the 2am start in 2025
A night race, and the 2026 marathon starts even earlier, at 12.30am
Not flat: short, sharp climbs near 3 km, in town and late in the race
Entries are non-refundable and bibs cannot be transferred

faqs.question: When is the Elopura Marathon Sandakan 2026?
faqs.answer: The Elopura Marathon Sandakan 2026 is scheduled to take place on 22 November 2026. The race is held in Sandakan, Sabah, Malaysia, and is organized by the Persatuan Ortopedik Sandakan. Further details about the event schedule beyond the date have not been provided in available source material.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The Elopura Marathon Sandakan 2026 offers three distance categories: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, and a shorter 10km race. This gives participants of varying experience levels and fitness the option to choose a distance that suits them.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register?
faqs.answer: According to elopuramarathon.com, the half marathon entry is priced at RM140, while the full marathon entry costs RM170. Pricing for the 10km distance is not specified in the available source material, so interested participants may need to check directly with organizers for that detail.
